title: Automated and Autonomous Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy: Transformers and Generative Machine Learning for Image Optimization and Segmentation
content: Achieving a fully autonomous scanning transmission electron microscope (STEM) requires the ability to repeatably image over long periods of time maintaining high resolution, as well as the ability to automatically detect objects of interest under variable conditions. These are naturally tasks which microscopists, through experience, are well accustomed to, however, such ‘domain shifts’ are a significant problem for machine learning models.
